units.title: CSS class selectors
units.goal: Match HTML classes to CSS class selectors and apply styles.

units.title: CSS box size
units.goal: Use width and height to set horizontal and vertical content dimensions.

units.title: CSS border
units.goal: Use border to set thickness, style, and color.

units.title: CSS padding
units.goal: Use padding to set inner space between content and border.

claim.learnerCan: Match a CSS class selector to elements with that class.
Match a CSS tag selector to elements of that tag.
Generate a class selector from an HTML class name.
Choose width for horizontal size and height for vertical size.
Predict that width and height set content-box dimensions under the lesson assumptions.
Predict that border creates the visible boundary around the element.
Construct a border shorthand value from thickness, style, and color.
Predict that padding creates space between content and border.
Apply one padding value to all four sides.
Relate content, padding, and border and predict how padding and border affect outer size under the lesson assumptions.
